follow-up time: To a mean age of 3.3 months
exposure: exposure in the pre- and postnatal time periods
cohort: 746 infants from the Canadian Healthy Infant Longitudinal Development Study (CHILD) cohort
finding: Exposure to pets during pregnancy and postnatally was associated with an enrichment of Oscillospira and Ruminococcus in the infant gut microbiota, regardless of birth scenario.
mod_finding: The impact of pet ownership on infant gut microbiota varied under different birth scenarios, including vaginal birth with and without intrapartum antibiotic prophylaxis and cesarean section.
